caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
relations: A thin wooden strip is bent by hands into a bow shape, its ends held apart while the middle curves smoothly under pressure, showing flexibility without breaking.

The bend persists steadily without snapping or warping, maintaining the bow shape once released from the pressure.
